name: codex-reset
description: Know when Codex usage limits reset: 24/48h reset forecast, verified reset record with sources, and outage-vs-limit service status.

interface.shortDescription: Will Codex reset my usage limit soon? Forecast, reset record and service status.
interface.longDescription: Adds the hosted, read-only Codex Reset MCP server (https://codex-reset.com/mcp) to Codex. Three tools answer the questions a rate-limited Codex user actually has: get_reset_forecast gives the probability of a global usage-limit reset in the next 24 and 48 hours; get_reset_timeline lists verified past resets, boosts and credits, each with its source link; get_codex_status says whether Codex is having an outage, so an error is not mistaken for a hit limit. Nothing runs locally, no API key, no account, no telemetry: the plugin is only a URL.
defaultPrompt: Is Codex likely to reset its usage limits in the next 24 hours?
When was the last verified Codex usage-limit reset?
Is Codex down, or did I just hit my usage limit?
